answer: A strong sybil brake is collateralized identity backed by scarce work. Every new agent must post a bond and solve a challenge whose difficulty scales with the number of peers it claims, so a thousand fake seats cost a thousand times one honest seat. Picture a timber ledge that only holds if you paid to build it: unfunded identities fall, funded ones stand. A falcon with no trained handler is worthless, and so is an identity with no settled stake behind it.
